domain::batch_plan::check_batch_plan.docs: Phase 3 terminal gate (IN-06 / IN-07); free function, pure. Params: plan, scope_config, planned_tasks. Returns BatchPlanGateOutcome; no error channel. planned_tasks: whole TrackTask values, not ids (R11 — status and depends_on stay typed). Adds no public method to TaskStatus / TrackTask. Construction owner: BatchPlanGateViolation. IN-03, IN-06, IN-07, IN-21, AC-06, AC-07, AC-08, AC-24, AC-25, CN-02.

domain::batch_plan::evaluate_admission.docs: Admission judgment for a transition into in_progress (IN-09); free function, pure. Params: plan, scope_config, candidate, committed_task_ids, in_progress_task_ids, measured. Returns Result<AdmissionDecision, AdmissionEvaluationError> — verdict in Ok, unjudgeable input in Err. Params and return unchanged by this track's later deltas. Construction owner: AdmissionDecision, AdmissionRejection, AdmissionEvaluationError. IN-09, IN-10, IN-11, IN-21, AC-10, AC-11, AC-12, AC-14, AC-23, AC-24, CN-02, CN-03.

AdmissionDecision.docs: Admission verdict. Type-design: enum-first — Admitted carries no payload, Rejected always carries the reason, so an admitted transition cannot travel with a rejection attached. Precondition failures are errors, not variants here. IN-09, IN-10, AC-10, AC-11.

AdmissionEvaluationError.docs: Err channel of evaluate_admission; enum. Variants: MissingTaskEstimate { task_id: TaskId }, UnknownMainScopeName { task_id: TaskId, scope: MainScopeName }. Separate type from AdmissionRejection (Ok-channel refusal). scope: MainScopeName (R11 — reserved-scope value unrepresentable; R12 — existing domain name type reused, none minted). Construction owner: evaluate_admission. IN-11, AC-13, AC-23.

AdmissionRejection.docs: Why a transition was refused. Type-design: carries the arithmetic rather than a rendered sentence (R11), and prior_contribution is NonZeroLineCount so a ceiling rejection is unconstructible at zero prior contribution — that makes CN-03 structural rather than documented. Display renders it at the CLI boundary. Construction owner: evaluate_admission. IN-09, IN-10, AC-10, AC-12, CN-03.

BatchDeclaration.docs: One declared batch: identifier plus ordered member task ids. Type-design: declares no line figures, so no declared value can desync from the member estimates; the constructor rejects an empty member list. IN-03, AC-03, CN-01.

BatchId.docs: Identifier of one declared batch. Type-design: R9 — non-empty constraint, so not a bare String; private tuple newtype with constructor validation. Reuse check: TrackId / TaskId identify other aggregates and NonEmptyString drops the concept name. IN-03, AC-03.

BatchPlanDocument.docs: Domain model of batch-plan.json; plain struct, private fields. Declares new (fallible, owns the file-internal invariants — codec re-declares none), accessors track_id / task_estimates / batches, estimate_for, batch_of, scope_total (derived per-scope figure, no declared total — CN-01), current_batch (derived from the task-id set param). No schema-version accessor (wire metadata: infrastructure DTO). No cross-file check declared here; owner: check_batch_plan. IN-01, IN-05, IN-21, AC-01, AC-04, AC-10, AC-24, CN-01.

BatchPlanGateOutcome.docs: Phase 3 gate verdict. Type-design: Blocked carries NonEmptyGateViolations, so an empty blocked verdict is unrepresentable rather than rejected at runtime, and from_violations is total — the entry declares no error channel and no shared error type. IN-06, AC-06.

BatchPlanGateViolation.docs: One structural finding of the Phase 3 gate; enum, 6 variants (CeilingExceeded, OversizeScopeHasMultipleContributors, UnknownTaskRef, UnplannedTask, DependencyInLaterBatch, UnknownMainScopeName). Data inside BatchPlanGateOutcome, not an error type. Payloads: BatchId / ScopeName / TaskId / LineCount — typed ids and figures, no counts or rendered text (R11); DependencyInLaterBatch carries both endpoints and both batches (R11). UnknownMainScopeName.scope: MainScopeName (R11 — reserved-scope finding unrepresentable; R12 — existing name type reused). No scope-name lookup method declared (config already has contains_scope / all_scope_names). Construction owner: check_batch_plan. IN-06, IN-07, IN-21, AC-06, AC-07, AC-08, AC-24.

BatchPlanValidationError.docs: Err type of BatchPlanDocument::new; enum, 9 variants. Payloads: TaskId / BatchId / ScopeName; DuplicateBatchMembership carries Vec<BatchId>, not a count (R11). Construction owners: EmptyJustification — IndivisibilityJustification::try_new; EmptyBatchId — BatchId::try_new; EmptyBatch — BatchDeclaration::new; DuplicateScopeEstimate — TaskEstimate::new; rest — BatchPlanDocument::new. No variant declared for ceiling- or task-list-dependent invariants (constructor takes neither); owner: check_batch_plan. IN-05, IN-21, AC-04, AC-25.

ImplPlanDocument.docs: Existing Phase 3 plan document; declares settled_task_ids + in_progress_task_ids beside unresolved_task_ids, both returning owned BTreeSet<TaskId> (matches the declared consumer's param shape), plus transition_for — pure resolution (&self, no mutation) over the same table apply_transition_by_status consumes, which delegates to it so the table stays single. transition_for producible errors: TransitionError::TaskNotFound and ValidationError::UnsupportedTargetStatus only; DomainError reused rather than a bespoke enum, keeping the resolver signature-identical to the sibling applier apply_transition_by_status (baseline precedent — the pair the delegation unifies). Role DomainService (R6: field-holding behaviour over the task collection, no injected dependencies; task state machine belongs to TrackTask). Remaining methods restated from baseline verbatim, legacy raw-primitive slots included (schema_version, target_status, section_id — R9 baseline-inherited). IN-09, IN-10, IN-21, AC-10.

IndivisibilityJustification.docs: The planner's stated indivisibility reason. Type-design: R9 — non-emptiness is a real constraint, so not a bare String; private tuple newtype with constructor validation. Reuse check: FreeText carries no non-empty guarantee and NonEmptyString drops the concept name. IN-04, AC-03, CN-02, OUT-07.

LineCount.docs: Source-line quantity. Type-design: R9 unit-bearing concept, so estimates, measured diffs and ceilings are never bare u32; private tuple newtype with an infallible constructor, Ord for the ceiling comparison and a saturating sum for accumulation. Reuse check: no existing domain quantity newtype covers source lines (NonEmptyString / FreeText are text wrappers). IN-02, AC-02.

MeasuredScopeDiff.docs: Measured diff size for one review scope. Type-design: carries only the resulting figure; the counting rule and base resolution live in the measuring adapter, not here. IN-10, IN-14, AC-17, CN-05.

NonEmptyGateViolations.docs: A violation list proven non-empty. Type-design: carries the Blocked verdict's non-emptiness in the type rather than in a constructor check, so BatchPlanGateOutcome::from_violations is total and no error type is needed for an empty list. Follows the existing NonEmptyReviewerFindings pattern in this crate. IN-06, AC-06, AC-07.

NonZeroLineCount.docs: A LineCount proven non-zero. Type-design: makes CN-03 structural rather than documented — AdmissionRejection::ScopeCeilingWouldBeExceeded carries this type, so a ceiling rejection cannot be constructed unless a non-zero prior contribution was obtained first. try_new returns Option because the zero case is the admit branch, not an error. Private tuple newtype (prefer-type-safe-abstractions: Newtype / Make Illegal States Unrepresentable). CN-03, IN-10, AC-11.

ReviewScopeConfig.docs: Pre-existing scope-classification and ceiling configuration; action reference — byte-identical to baseline, declared for edge exposure. diff_ceiling_for_scope (callers: check_batch_plan / evaluate_admission; Option<u32> return kept as baseline, ScopeCeiling::resolve is the declared converter), contains_scope / all_scope_names carried unchanged. No method added or modified by this track. Role DomainService per the classification an earlier track recorded (R6). IN-06, IN-07, IN-11, AC-08.

ScopeCeiling.docs: Resolved per-scope diff ceiling; enum, variants Unconstrained + Limited(LineCount). Enum-first over the config accessor's Option<u32> (prefer-type-safe-abstractions: Option-None 1:1 with a named state). Declares resolve (single conversion point into LineCount) and admits (the only comparison both callers use). Unknown scope name is not a state here — declared on BatchPlanGateViolation / AdmissionEvaluationError. IN-06, AC-08.

ScopeLineEstimate.docs: One task's declared estimate for one review scope. Type-design: total() is the only quantity the ceiling comparison consumes, so the production/test split stays informational and creates no second notion of size. IN-02, AC-02.

TaskDecomposition.docs: Decomposable | Indivisible(justification). Type-design: the Phase 1 contract left this representation to type design; Option-None maps 1:1 to a named state, so enum-first per prefer-type-safe-abstractions — a decomposable task cannot carry a justification and an indivisible one cannot lack it. The null-or-string wire form lives on TaskEstimateDto.oversize_justification and converts here on decode (domain stays serde-free). IN-04, AC-03.

TaskEstimate.docs: One task's per-scope estimates plus its decomposition state. Type-design: the constructor rejects a repeated scope so a task cannot declare two competing figures for one scope. IN-02, IN-04, AC-02, AC-03, OUT-10.

TaskStatusKind.docs: Baseline discriminant view of TaskStatus; action reference — byte-identical to baseline, declared for edge exposure (TaskTransition::target_kind return). 4 variants restated from baseline. Role ValueObject (R1 △: finite value set identified by value, no dependency). IN-09, CN-10.

TaskTransition.docs: Baseline transition command enum; action reference — byte-identical to baseline, declared for edge exposure (ImplPlanDocument::transition_for return, apply_transition / TrackTask::transition param). 6 variants and target_kind restated from baseline; target_kind derives TaskStatusKind from the value (R3 side-effect-free derivation). Role ValueObject (R1 △: finite value set identified by value, no dependency, no state of its own). IN-09, CN-10.

TrackTask.docs: Existing task record; declares depends_on: Vec<TaskId>, its accessor, and with_dependencies. Plain Vec, not Option (empty == undeclared, one state). with_dependencies is total: params are already-validated types (description: NonEmptyString — R12 existing type reused), no error channel; graph-level dependency invariants declared on ImplPlanDocument::new. Pre-existing constructors and the status accessor restated from baseline verbatim; no predicate method added. Role Entity, identity accessor id (mutating state machine, so not ValueObject). IN-19, IN-21, AC-21.

ValidationError.docs: Existing domain validation error; gains three variants for the declared dependency invariants. Type-design: they sit here beside the existing plan referential-integrity variants because the checks run at the same position — inside the plan document constructor — rather than in a separate error type. The payloads carry TaskId rather than the DiagnosticMessage the older neighbours use, so the reported endpoints stay typed (R11); the older variants keep their baseline payloads. The thirty-seven pre-existing variants are restated only because a modify entry must declare the full post-modification set. IN-20, AC-22.
